text:
Riley: Partners want coordinated regional onramps for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Thinking staggered marketplace listings + press to avoid capacity spikes. Good idea?

Asha: Yes. Must define hard gates: lab cert, firmware freeze, SKU naming. SIs need a 7-10 day test window.

Diego: Ops note 10: H200 microcode still has a flaky regression in perf tests. Recommend routing fallback to `h200-quant` and `b200-small` as graceful options.

Fiona: Comms: do NOT do a single global press. Proposed cadence NA -> EU -> APAC over ~2 weeks. Need embargo copy by Friday to hold NA slot. @Riley can you take that?

Nina: SI asks: sample AMIs/images + kernel tags + a tiny harness. If we lock kernel targets today my team will produce a CI matrix and upload images to s3.

Riley: Draft staging plan below, internal first so legal can review before we loop press.

```
staging_v0:
Day 0: internal SI enablement, sample images
Day 2: NA marketplace preview (limited SKUs)
Day 8: EU GA for core SKUs; MI300 limited beta
Day 14: APAC GA + press window
Press: NA T, EU T+7d, APAC T+14d
Fallbacks: region routing -> quantized variants -> throttled burst pools
```

Asha: Also standardize SKU names now. Last time naming mismatch caused onboarding failures.

Diego: I'll add fallback mapping and validate routing in staging region by Tue. Taking action item.

Nina: I'll upload images to s3://partners/staging/ and share creds with SIs today. CI matrix coming.

Fiona: DeployBot, can you post daily rollup to #partnerships during the staging window?

DeployBot: Scheduled daily rollup to #partnerships from 2024-06-10 to 2024-06-18.

Riley: If everyone confirms dates I'll lock the plan and schedule a 30m legal+press sync tomorrow. Please tag marketplace PRs in `marketplace-changes`.

Asha: Confirmed.

Diego: Confirmed.

Nina: Confirmed.

Fiona: Confirmed.
